name: Victor Grantz
source:
"I just... want to know the truth."

The young man who claims to be a British sheriff. Needing to go to the UK, he hurriedly boards the Nord Express. A puppy named Wick accompanies him wherever he goes.

[Taken from the [url=https://norusatsu.carrd.co/#actors]official website[/url]]
